record.paper_title: Problemas abiertos en series de Fourier de Jacobi-Sobolev
record.context_brief: Generalized Jacobi weights in Sobolev products
record.original_question: Let w(x)=h(x)(1-x)^alpha(1+x)^beta product_{j=1}^N |x-t_j|^gamma_j on [-1,1], where alpha,beta,gamma_j > -1, the points t_j are distinct points in (-1,1), h is continuous and positive on [-1,1], and the modulus of continuity condition w(h,delta) delta^(-1) is integrable on (0,2). For the discrete Sobolev-type inner product formed from w(x)dx and finitely many derivative-evaluation mass terms, extend the known upper estimates for orthogonal polynomials with generalized Jacobi weights to this Sobolev-type setting.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $w$ be a generalized Jacobi weight on $[-1,1]$ of the form
$$w(x) = h(x)(1-x)^{\alpha}(1+x)^{\beta}\prod_{j=1}^{N}|x-t_j|^{\gamma_j},$$
where $\alpha,\beta,\gamma_j>-1$, $t_1,\dots,t_N$ are distinct points in $(-1,1)$, and $h$ is continuous and strictly positive on $[-1,1]$ with modulus of continuity $\omega(h,\delta)$ satisfying $\int_0^2 \omega(h,\delta)\,\delta^{-1}\,d\delta < \infty$.

Fix points $c_1,\dots,c_M\in\mathbb{R}$, nonnegative integers $k_1,\dots,k_M$, and positive masses $\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_M>0$. Define the discrete Sobolev-type inner product
$$\langle f,g\rangle_S = \int_{-1}^{1} f(x)g(x)\,w(x)\,dx + \sum_{i=1}^{M}\lambda_i f^{(k_i)}(c_i)g^{(k_i)}(c_i),$$
and let $\{q_n\}_{n\geq 0}$ denote the sequence of polynomials orthonormal with respect to $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_S$.

For ordinary orthonormal polynomials $\{p_n\}$ associated with generalized Jacobi weights of this type, pointwise upper estimates of the form
$$|p_n(x)|\,\sqrt{w(x)}\,\big(\sqrt{1-x^2}+1/n\big)^{1/2} \leq C$$
(with appropriate modifications near the endpoints and the singular points $t_j$) are known.

Problem: Extend these pointwise upper estimates to the Sobolev-type orthonormal polynomials $q_n$ associated with $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_S$; that is, establish analogous uniform pointwise bounds for $q_n(x)$ on $[-1,1]$ in terms of $n$, the weight $w$, and the discrete Sobolev data $(c_i,k_i,\lambda_i)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Pointwise upper estimates for orthonormal polynomials with generalized Jacobi weights are classical (Badkov, Nevai), and asymptotic/upper-bound results exist for several Jacobi-Sobolev settings. However, no source located clearly establishes the analogous uniform pointwise upper estimates for discrete Sobolev-type inner products with a fully general generalized Jacobi weight including interior singularities $|x-t_j|^{\gamma_j}$. The problem appears to remain open in this generality.

status_evidence.title: Generalized Jacobi Weights, Christoffel Functions, and Jacobi Polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Pointwise upper bounds and Christoffel function estimates for generalized Jacobi weights.
status_evidence.claim: Pointwise estimates are established in the non-Sobolev (classical) generalized Jacobi setting.

status_evidence.title: Jacobi-Sobolev Orthogonal Polynomials: Asymptotics for N-Coherence of Measures
status_evidence.snippet: Mehler-Heine-type formula, inner strong asymptotics, and upper bounds for Jacobi-Sobolev orthonormal polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial pointwise/asymptotic results in restricted Jacobi-Sobolev settings are available.
